title: BARBELL BENCH PRESS
description: A compound press that builds chest thickness, triceps, and pressing power from a stable bench.
instructions: Lie flat on the bench with your feet planted firmly on the ground.
Grip the barbell slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Lower the bar slowly to your mid-chest while keeping your elbows at a 45-degree angle.
Press the bar back up explosively to the starting position.

title: INCLINE DUMBBELL PRESS
description: Targets the upper pectoral muscles and anterior deltoids using free weights for maximum range.
instructions: Set the incline bench to a 30-45 degree angle.
Sit back with a dumbbell in each hand resting on your thighs.
Kick the weights up to shoulder height and press them straight up.
Lower slowly until you feel a stretch in your upper chest.

title: BARBELL SQUAT
description: The king of lower body exercises, strengthening quads, glutes, hamstrings, and core stability.
instructions: Position the barbell across your upper back/traps.
Unrack and step back with feet shoulder-width apart.
Inhale, brace your core, and squat down until thighs are parallel to the floor.
Drive up through your heels to return to standing.

title: DEADLIFT
description: A total-body compound movement emphasizing posterior chain strength and back thickness.
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart, shins close to the bar.
Hinge at hips, grip the bar, and pull chest up with a flat back.
Drive through legs to lift the bar close to your body.
Lock out hips at top, then lower under control.

title: PULL-UP
description: An essential bodyweight exercise that builds wide lats, upper back density, and grip strength.
instructions: Grip the pull-up bar with hands wider than shoulder-width, palms facing away.
Hang with arms fully extended.
Pull your chest up toward the bar by driving elbows down.
Pause at the top, then lower back down fully.

title: OVERHEAD SHOULDER PRESS
description: Builds overhead strength, shoulder width, and upper body posture using a barbell.
instructions: Hold barbell at upper chest height with hands shoulder-width apart.
Brace core and glutes to maintain a stable base.
Press the bar straight overhead until arms fully lock out.
Lower back down smoothly to shoulder height.

title: BARBELL BICEP CURL
description: Classic isolation lift designed for maximum bicep engagement and forearm strength.
instructions: Stand tall holding a barbell with underhand grip.
Keep elbows close to your torso at all times.
Curl weight up toward shoulders while keeping upper arms still.
Squeeze biceps at peak, then slowly lower.

title: TRICEP DIPS
description: Bodyweight movement isolating triceps while engaging chest and front shoulders.
instructions: Grip parallel bars and push up to starting arm-extended position.
Lower your body by bending elbows until upper arms are parallel to floor.
Keep torso slightly upright to isolate triceps.
Push back up to starting position.

title: RUSSIAN TWIST
description: Core stability exercise focusing on rotational strength and oblique development.
instructions: Sit on floor with knees bent and feet elevated slightly.
Hold medicine ball in front of your chest.
Twist torso to the right, touching weight to floor.
Rotate smoothly to the left side and repeat.

title: DUMBBELL LATERAL RAISE
description: Isolates the side deltoids to create shoulder width and V-taper appearance.
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells by your sides with slight elbow bend.
Raise arms out to sides until parallel with floor.
Pause briefly at top of movement.
Lower weights back down slowly.

title: LEG PRESS
description: Machine-based leg workout allowing heavy quad and glute loading with spine support.
instructions: Sit in machine, place feet hip-width apart on sled platform.
Release safety bars and lower weight toward chest until knees reach 90 degrees.
Press weight back up without locking knees at top.
Keep lower back flat against seat throughout.

title: PLANK WITH ARM LIFT
description: Advanced core stabilization challenge testing shoulder anti-rotation and abs.
instructions: Get into forearm plank position with elbows under shoulders.
Keep feet hip-width for balance.
Slowly extend right arm straight forward without twisting hips.
Lower and repeat on left arm.
